description: This file defines a PHP class named pSurface, which is used for creating and manipulating surface charts in the pChart library. It includes properties and methods for setting up grid points, adding data points, rendering labels and contours, drawing the surface, and handling missing data points.

classes.name: pSurface
classes.description: Class to draw surface charts in the pChart PHP library, including methods for grid management, data point addition, label rendering, contour drawing, surface rendering, and missing data computation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the pSurface object with the associated pChart object and default properties.

methods.name: setGrid
methods.description: Defines the size of the grid and initializes the internal points matrix to UNKNOWN.

methods.name: addPoint
methods.description: Adds a data point at specified grid coordinates, with optional forcing of overwriting existing values.

methods.name: writeXLabels
methods.description: Outputs labels along the X-axis, with customizable format and positioning.

methods.name: writeYLabels
methods.description: Outputs labels along the Y-axis, with customizable format and positioning.

methods.name: drawContour
methods.description: Draws contour lines around a specified threshold value.

methods.name: drawSurface
methods.description: Renders the surface chart based on the grid points and optional palette shading.

methods.name: computeMissing
methods.description: Interpolates and fills in missing (UNKNOWN) data points based on nearest neighbors.

methods.name: getNearestNeighbor
methods.description: Calculates the distance to the nearest non-unknown data point from a given coordinate.
